summary: Verified mobile clipping bug fix on /play page. Tested at mobile (390x844) and desktop (1280x900) viewports. All elements (top toolbar, HUD 4 columns, canvas, joystick, pause) are within viewport bounds with no clipping. Scroll is fully locked. Menu navigation and Mute toggle still work.
critical_code_review_comments: Game.jsx useEffect depends only on [character] with eslint-disable — 'mode' change would not reinitialize the engine. Minor concern; ok for current UX since mode is chosen from menu before navigation.
TouchControls uses 640px breakpoint via window.innerWidth; SSR-safe check present. OK.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile layout fix verified. Measurements at 390x844: canvas bottom=583.2, joystick bottom=836, pause_touch bottom=795.6, hud bottom=112, toolbar bottom=37 — all < 844. Desktop 1280x900: canvas bottom=670.4, joystick bottom=892, all clean. window.scrollY stays 0 after wheel/scroll attempts. Menu button returns to '/'. Mute toggles aria-label between Mute/Unmute. All 10 review checks in this iteration passed.
rca of the issue: Previous clipping was caused by fixed canvas dimensions overflowing on small viewports. Fix uses flex column with canvas maxWidth/maxHeight 100% + width/height auto preserving 546x494 aspect. Verified working.
